experimental_unit: one LIBERO suite/task rollout at development init-state 10

fixed_factors.process_lifetime: one fresh persistent policy process per arm

eligibility: ROCm telemetry has zero sampling errors
selection_rule.primary: maximize complete sparse task successes over 40 paired development units
selection_rule.tie_breaker: prefer larger action_steps to reduce model inference calls and package energy
selection_rule.promotion: a non-control arm must strictly exceed steps10_control before full 400-unit development evaluation

claim_boundary: Development-only runtime screening. It is not a public LIBERO score and cannot establish model superiority.
